newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks open mixed, News Corp drags.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks open mixed, News Corp drags.

text.p: Australian shares opened mixed on Tuesday as media giant News Corp dragged on the market after its first quarter profit result came in below market expectations.
The Murdoch media group posted an 8.1-percent drop in net profit to A$283 million ($223 million) for the three months to September 30.
From the opening, the All Ordinaries index lost 1.7 points to 2,356.4.
A mildly firmer resources sector, bouyed by stronger metals prices, limited early losses.

"It's not doing a great deal with News Corp the obvious factor," said a Sydney broker, noting that the resource leaders had edged higher early, helping to overcome an industrials sector impacted by News Corp's fall.
"The miners held it up early but they are coming off now."
Turnover remained at only moderate levels with Monday's holiday in the U.S. ensuring many players remained uncommitted.
Expectations were for a single figure finish with little inspiration for investors to work with.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about five to three, while about 44 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
